info.description: Controls the pacing of the live simulation and streams its plant events. Plant events: WebSocket at /api/v1/events (see docs/contracts/simulator-control-api.md).

get.description: The ground truth a headless run would write if it ended now, kept live while the run is paced. Reconciliation tests compare the MES with it (#100). Reading it never moves the run.

epoch.description: Run epoch (Unix seconds), as the devices publish it (ADR-0015)

simTime.description: How far events have been processed, ISO 8601 UTC; the totals count up to here

pacedTime.description: The paced simulation clock when this was read, ISO 8601 UTC; simTime trails it by up to about 1 s × speed while running

currentBucket.description: The shift bucket the run is in: `2026-10-12/A` or `no-shift`

buckets.description: Every bucket seen; complete once the run has left it (`no-shift` collects every gap between shifts and can be entered again)

current.description: Each machine's current state and when it began

machines.description: Per machine, as in the headless summary.json

quality.description: good / produced; null when PBT = 0 or nothing was produced

oee.description: (ideal × good) / (PBT × produced); null when PBT = 0 or anomaly
